content:
Sophia (mktg): quick brainstorm — we need a low-friction weekly nudge for trial signups that haven't hit 3 api calls in 7 days. keep it light, product-first.
Ashley (growth): love. target cohort = trial_started && <3 api_calls && created_at > 7_days_ago. want to test 3 cadences: day 3, day 7, day 14.
Mike (analytics): can add an engagement_score and expected uplift estimate. i'll add cohort and baseline conv rates to the dashboard.
Lena (content): short subject options: "Quick tip to get instant value from Redwood", "Ship an LLM feature in 10 min", "Your trial — faster wins". i can draft variants.
Jordan (ops): delivery constraints — keep send windows 12pm-4pm PST. throttle to 10k/hr to avoid provider limits.
Sophia (mktg): sequencing idea: microflow A = tip + one-click quickstart (link to template), microflow B = benchmark narrative (small measurable win), microflow C = invite to 20-min office hours. rotate.
Ashley (growth): add a reactivation path: if no clicks after microflow A+B, send an experiment with case study + discount code on day 21.
Mike (analytics): timeline & metrics: open rate, click-to-quickstart, api_calls_7days_post_send, trial->paid within 30d. i'll instrument a derived metric `post_send_api_delta`.
Lena (content): i'll write 3 subject lines x 2 bodies (short vs. long) and include one image-less variant for deliverability.
Sophia (mktg): can we do dynamic snippets? show top three playground templates by org size. Ashley, can product supply that?
Ashley (growth): yes, we can surface top templates via the API — ping Jordan to get an endpoint stub.
Jordan (ops): created endpoint stub: `GET /marketing/templates?size={{org_size}}` — returning top3. pushing to staging now.
marvin-bot: deploy started for stub-marketing-templates to staging (build #8421).
Mike (analytics): once endpoint's in staging i'll wire up the AB test cohorts and start collecting signals. recommend stratified randomization by org_size.
Sophia (mktg): rollout plan: week 0 = 5% of cohort, week 1 = 25%, week 2 = 100% if no regressions. rollback if conversion delta < -10% vs baseline.
Lena (content): subject tests i'll push to notion: https://notion.redwood.com/mktg/newsletter/nudge-cadence (drafts in there).
Ashley (growth): need one-pager for SDRs so they know which leads to prioritize — high click + low api usage = outreach within 48hrs. I'll draft.
Jordan (ops): note on suppression: honor `do_not_email` flag and engagement_restriction from privacy settings.
Sophia (mktg): quick checklist before send: templates endpoint in staging, analytics events in prod-schema, content variants in SES, throttle configured, sdr playbook done. who owns each?
Mike (analytics): analytics events — me.
Jordan (ops): endpoint & throttle — me.
Lena (content): content variants — me.
Ashley (growth): sdr playbook — me.
Sophia (mktg): owner of rollout decision — me. will call for go/no-go on Friday EOD.
Lena (content): draft ETA = tomorrow noon.
Mike (analytics): cohort instrumentation ETA = today EOD.
Jordan (ops): endpoint live in staging in ~30m.
marvin-bot: deploy succeeded for stub-marketing-templates on staging (build #8421) :white_check_mark:
Ashley (growth): nice. once staging smoke tests pass we can seed 1% for QA.
Sophia (mktg): question — subject personalization token: use `{{product_feature}}` or keep generic? personalization improves opens but can break templates. thoughts?
Lena (content): prefer `{{top_template}}` (fallback = "starter template"). less product-bleed, still relevant.
Mike (analytics): track template rendering errors; count fallback rate. if >2% fallback we pause personalization.
Sophia (mktg): agreed. last: add a small survey link in the day 14 email asking "what held you back?" 1-click options. quick signal for product.
Ashley (growth): love the survey. will add as hidden property for SDR routing.
Sophia (mktg): perfect. will sync Friday 10am for final go/no-go. thanks team :rocket: 
Jordan (ops): noted — dev/ops standby Friday 9:30-11:30 for fast rollback if needed.
Mike (analytics): i'll have a dashboard ready and slack alert on delta.
Lena (content): will finalize variants and send preview.
marvin-bot: reminder scheduled: #marketing Friday 10:00 — "Nudge cadence go/no-go"
Sophia (mktg): ends.
